question: What form does one-pointed meditation mind make in many ways?
premises: bahudhā rūpaṃ means form in many ways
dhyāna eka gata cetasaḥ means one-pointed meditation mind
inference: One-pointed meditation mind makes form in many ways.
uncertainties: whether eka gata modifies cetasaḥ or dhyāna
plain_english: One-pointed meditation mind makes form in many ways.
